mission.title: Following the Trail
mission.description: Follow the leads from Zion's disk to a redpill who knew Anome.

npc.say: Be careful out there! Some of his friends are pretty clever.

phase.briefing: It is time to pursue some leads from that disk, {player}. There is a redpill named Achilles who has apparently interacted with Anome in the past. It is very possible that he may be able to give us some guidance regarding Anome's present location.

enter.say: Looks like Achilles is some sort of hacker.

talk.say:
Hey, so you're the Machine person tracking this whole thing down, right? Thank god.
You know, it was only a matter of time before Anome pulled a stunt like this. I always did have my eye on him. That Niobe got hurt, or worse... he's going to pay for this.
I think I know a place where you might turn up something more. He used to meet with some of his shady friends there.

done.say:
Okay, time to get over to-- That's strange. I just saw a weird code in there... no, now it's gone. Maybe I'm seeing things.
Anyhow, time to get over to this meeting place.

phase.briefing: The location of the alleged meeting place is on your HUD. Proceed there and scour the area for any information.

enter.say: This place is looking pretty empty. Check any computers, desks, anything you can find.

done.say: That makes no sense, but I'm reading that weird code fluctuation-- Whoa, incoming!
Ambushed by Niobe's people? I think we'd better go back and pay Achilles another little visit.

phase.briefing: Achilles has moved from his previous location. He has been tracked to the location indicated; apparently he is making an attempt to escape us. Proceed there as fast as possible and intercept him.

enter.say: I'm reading that weird code signature again, and... it doesn't look like Achilles is here anymore? That's weird. Take a look around.

done.say: Damn it! He's dead... see if you can find anything and then get out. That code signature is freaking me out.

mission.finish:
Most... perplexing. I fear that the vials are already at play here.
I shall contact you soon.
